case: A transfer names a constraint set that need not resolve, so the founder-facing brief crosses an untyped boundary again.
why: R-X27 requires a constraint set on every transfer the fixtures name, INCLUDING the continuation and the founder-facing brief. `constraint_set_ref` occurred twice in the whole schema, on one record, and was not required even there. With the binding optional, a `DecisionPacket` or an `OperatorProjection` names a set that resolves to nothing and is presented anyway -- which is uniform gap G-05, and the one reader whose errors are uncorrelated with the model family's is the one on the untyped side of it.
